content: Windows subprocess gotchas for a web service spawning CLI scripts: Popen.terminate()/kill() = TerminateProcess kills ONLY the target, children survive; the reliable tree-kill is taskkill /F /T /PID <pid> run hidden. asyncio subprocess terminate on Windows Proactor has known hang issues (bpo-37381) - prefer taskkill then await wait_for(proc.wait(), timeout). Spawn children with creationflags=CREATE_NO_WINDOW (subprocess.CREATE_NO_WINDOW) so no console flashes; pass it to the taskkill invocation too. Some codebases sidestep asyncio subprocess entirely on Windows by running Popen inside asyncio.to_thread. Use creationflags=CREATE_NO_WINDOW | CREATE_NEW_PROCESS_GROUP where needed.
